build_SVTRNet_model: build an SVTRNet OCR recognition model with configurable image size, embed dimensions, and attention mixers
create_PatchEmbed_layer: create a PatchEmbed layer that converts input images into patch sequences for transformer processing
run_SVTRNet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SVTRNet on a batch of input images to produce OCR feature outputs
test_Attention_mixer: test the Attention module with Global, Local, or Conv mixer modes on sequence inputs
review_Block_residual: review the Block class that combines attention or conv mixer, MLP, and residual connections with prenorm or postnorm
